known.title: The report drops an unknown pair answer for a known defect that the run found
known.summary: scoreRun keeps an `unknown` pair answer only as an unresolved known defect, and only when the run did not find that defect (score.mjs:367 and 395). Example: finding F1 matches D1, and finding F2 has an `unknown` answer for D1 and the rating `valid`. The run then shows one valid extra and zero unresolved, and no field of the run, the summary, or the report tables (score.mjs:427-439, 449-484) shows the unknown answer. So the reader cannot see that the valid extra can be only a repeat of D1. Plan decision 6 says that the report gives the unresolved judgments.
